app.title: The ZINN App
app.description: CBT-based belief management with AI insights

settingsDialogs.themeDesc: Choose your preferred theme or switch automatically by time of day.
settingsDialogs.autoDesc: Light during the day, dark at night
settingsDialogs.textSizeDesc: Adjust text size throughout the app for easier reading. Capped at 130% to keep layouts intact on mobile.

beliefs.enterPlaceholder: Enter your {type}... Sayings and quotes that you live by or have heard from others...

thinkingReport.subtitle: CBT-based thought analysis. Fill in what you can, and AI will complete the rest.

thinkingReport.behaviorPlaceholder: What did you do as a result of this thought?
thinkingReport.replacementThoughtPlaceholder: What is a healthier way to think about this?
thinkingReport.associatedBeliefPlaceholder: What core belief does this thought connect to?
thinkingReport.analyzing: AI is completing your CBT Thinking Report...
thinkingReport.noReportsDesc: Start by entering your first thought above.

boundaries.title: Boundaries
boundaries.subtitle: AI-generated boundaries that complement your pro-social beliefs across all boundary types.
boundaries.generateDesc: Select a specific pro-social belief to generate targeted boundaries, or generate from all beliefs.
boundaries.addBeliefsFirst: Add pro-social beliefs first to generate boundaries.
boundaries.analyzing: AI is generating relevant boundaries for your beliefs...
boundaries.noBoundariesDesc: Add pro-social beliefs first, then generate boundaries.
boundaries.deleteAllConfirm: Delete all {count} boundaries? This cannot be undone.
boundaries.deleteDesc: Are you sure you want to delete "{title}"? This cannot be undone.

maslow.title: Maslow's Hierarchy of Needs
maslow.subtitle: Identify which unmet needs may be driving your thoughts and behaviors from your CBT reports.
maslow.analyzeReportDesc: Select a thinking report to auto-populate its thoughts and behaviors, then let AI identify unmet needs.
maslow.noReports: No thinking reports yet. Add one in the Thinking Report section first.
maslow.noAnalysesDesc: Select a thinking report above to begin.
maslow.analyzing: AI is analyzing your needs across Maslow's hierarchy...

scriptureLookup.title: Scripture Lookup
scriptureLookup.subtitle: Search by reference, partial quote, or paraphrase — AI finds the passage and generates a matching affirmation & philosophy.
scriptureLookup.placeholder: e.g. 'John 3:16', 'love is patient love is kind', or 'the one about not being anxious about tomorrow'...

scriptureLookup.replaceNoticeAntiSocial: This replaces all anti-social scriptures in the selected reflection with this new result.

disclaimer.title: Medical & Psychological Disclaimer
disclaimer.intro: This app ("The ZINN App") is an AI-powered educational and self-reflection tool modeled after Abraham Maslow's historical five-tier "Hierarchy of Needs" psychological framework.
disclaimer.section1Title: 1. Not Medical, Psychological, or Mental Health Advice
disclaimer.section1Body: The Application's artificial intelligence analyzes text or user inputs to match them with generalized concepts of human motivation and unmet needs. This analysis does not constitute a clinical psychological assessment, psychiatric evaluation, mental health diagnosis, or medical treatment plan.
disclaimer.section2Body: Your use of the Application, its AI algorithms, and any generated outputs or recommendations do not establish a therapist-client, doctor-patient, or professional healthcare relationship between you and The ZINN App.
disclaimer.section3Body: This Application is not equipped to handle, diagnose, or treat mental health emergencies or crises. If you are experiencing an immediate mental health crisis, severe distress, or thoughts of self-harm, please contact emergency services or your local professional mental health helpline immediately.
disclaimer.section4Body: All AI-generated recommendations are for informational and educational purposes only. You should always consult with a licensed psychologist, psychiatrist, or medical professional before making major lifestyle or behavioral changes based on this app's outputs. Use of this Application is entirely at your own risk.
disclaimer.acceptLabel: I have read and understand the Medical and Psychological Disclaimer. I accept the terms and acknowledge that this app is an educational tool, not a medical or mental health service.
disclaimer.contextual: Disclaimer: This analysis is generated by an artificial intelligence model using historical literature (Maslow's Hierarchy of Needs) as an educational reference point. AI outputs can be inaccurate or incomplete. This is not a psychological evaluation or diagnostic tool. Please consult a licensed professional for mental health guidance or clinical evaluation.
